name: amfx-tsla-time-cover-research
description: amFX reproduction (12DEC25 p3): TSLA price chart 2020-2023 showing TIME Person of the Year contrarian indicator. Elon Musk named Person of the Year in Dec 2021, marking the exact top. TSLA fell ~65% in the year after. Chart shows daily close with 50d/200d MAs and a vertical reference at the cover date.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: TSLA x TIME Person of the Year (12DEC25 p3)
# =============================================================================
# Elon Musk named TIME Person of the Year: December 13, 2021
# TSLA peaked near $400 around that time, then crashed ~65% in 2022.
# This chart visualizes the contrarian indicator in action.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Moving averages for trend context
ma50 = ma(period=50)(close)
ma200 = ma(period=200)(close)

xy_lines(
    title='TSLA: Did TIME Person of the Year Mark the Top?',
    category='TIME Cover Indicator',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TSLA Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='200d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=352.26, title='Cover Date Price ~$352', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(close, ma50, ma200))
